label: prose:sm-open-problems
title: Open problems
html:
Open problems.

The following ledger consolidates the epistemic status of every structural ingredient this appendix uses; the per-parameter status of the 26 Standard-Model parameters is tabulated in the parameter sections above and is not repeated here. Items marked open name the missing object precisely; none of them is discharged elsewhere in this paper.

Ingredient Status Where
Gauge symmetry as action groupoid; reversal, gauge equivalence, residual-symmetry monoid proved (Lean, sorry-free) gauge action groupoid
Braid group onto H_n(q) by the Hecke relation standard Hecke algebra from braiding
Fibre gauge group \mathrm{Aut}^{\otimes}(\tau) \cong \mathrm{SU}(2) proved in the framework \mathrm{SU}(2) emergence
Faithful Hecke realization of gauge automorphisms conjectural (class, no instance) Hecke realization
Coulomb charge Q = w/2 derived, no fitted scale Coulomb charge
Writhe-to-isospin map w \mapsto I_3 derived (sign and ratio, scale-free) gauge truncation
Hypercharge Y open: writhe map falsified; candidate second datum defined — the strand twist, with gauge invariance Lean-proved and the first-generation spectrum battery run — but that battery corroborates nothing, proved sorry-free in QOU/StandardModel/TwistBatteryVacuity.lean: it collapses to the single linear equation T = 3Q per flavour (the -2I_3 common to candidate and target cancels, leaving the defining equation of Q_{\mathrm{twist}} rather than a test of it), the nucleon check is entailed by charge additivity, and the \mathbb{Z}_6 condition never sees the assignment. Each flavour is therefore filtered independently, so the 4 survivors are 1 \times 2 \times 2 \times 1 multiset counting against totals 3Q = (2,-1,0,-3) — not a 2500\!:\!1 filter — and the "uniquely determined" u and e multisets are simply the two totals admitting a single multiset. Whether the twist multisets are forced by the categorical braid words is the entire open content; the braid words are not missing — the knot-particle dictionary gives the quark braid element in \mathcal{B}_3 as a single generator (\sigma_i for \mathfrak{u}, \sigma_i^{-1} for \mathfrak{d}, \mathfrak{s}, \mathfrak{b}), so the quark writhe is \pm 1; what this closes off is the braid element as carrier, since the anti-up and the down share \sigma_i^{-1} yet carry -2/3 and -1/3 (QOU/StandardModel/QuarkBraidChargeObstruction.lean). The genuinely missing datum is the environment label — the up quark is "the unknot distinguished by its environment", and nothing formalizes that colour-tube datum. Chirality (u_L vs u_R) is likewise unrepresented strand twist datum; hypercharge invariant
\mathrm{SU}(3) colour factor from three-strand structure partially constructed: the stabilizer \mathfrak{su}(3) = \ker(\mathrm{ev}_e) carries the proved \dim = 8 gate, is a Lie subalgebra of \mathfrak{g}_2 (bracket closure, sorry-free), and acts faithfully on the octonion base module (\mathbf{1} \oplus \mathbf{3}, tautological instance); open: the action on the framework's own three-strand Hecke state space colour stabilizer action
\mathbb{Z}_6 global form of G_{\mathrm{SM}} doubly grounded: representation-kernel condition (Baez–Huerta) and geometric F_4-stabilizer derivation (Dubois-Violette–Todorov) agree; implemented as the battery condition \tau/3 + w/2 + Y/2 \in \mathbb{Z} hypercharge invariant
Truncation ("freeze-out") mechanism and suppression rate open: heuristic, no derivation selection-rules remark
Electroweak identifications W, Z, H = T(2,4), T(2,6), T(2,8) conjectural; ratio-level numerics within a factor of two electroweak triplet
Mass hierarchies from morphism amplitudes open: must reduce to the canonical volume–density / Hecke-energy mass chain mass identity
2-group refinement (morphisms between morphisms) unformalised; groupoid is the 1-truncation. Categorical home identified in the literature: the strand twist is an abelian-H, t = 0 crossed-module datum, and the automorphism 2-group of a state is the generic template self-dual 2-group remark; strand twist datum
Three-generation structure (why three copies of each fermion?) open, with an adjacent proved divisibility lemma. The genus bound g(T_{2,n}) = (n-1)/2 \leq 4 admits odd windings n \in \{3,5,7,9\}, and the continuant divisibility b_a \mid b_n \iff a \mid n (Lean, sorry-free) singles out 9 = 3\cdot3 as the unique harmonic (b_9 = b_3\,(h^6+6h^4+9h^2+1)), leaving \{3,5,7\}. This does not derive the number three. Within \{3,5,7,9\} the divisibility criterion selects exactly the composite, and compositeness carries no generation content — any criterion removing one of four candidates leaves three. The framework's other filter gives a different count: S_5-equivariance admits only \{3,5\}, since S_5 has no element of order 7 or 9, and it classes the tau together with the n = 9 ghost as symmetry-broken (symmetry-preserving leptons, S_5-equivariant torus knots). Nothing but harmonicity separates the observed tau from the unobserved ghost. Also open (scope-(a)): the physical bridge "normal-form-independent winding \Rightarrow generation" and the \mathrm{net}\to mass map neutrino-sector section; generation exclusion

Three of these are the items a derivation of the Standard Model cannot do without. The hypercharge assignment requires a second crossing invariant independent of the writhe; the strand twist datum now supplies a gauge-invariant candidate with the falsifiable consistency Q_{\mathrm{twist}} = Q against the crossing-derived charge, but deriving the per-fermion twist multisets from framework states — rather than enumerating them — remains open. The \mathrm{SU}(3) factor now has its algebra: the octonion stabilizer with proved dimension gate and bracket closure; what it lacks is an action on the framework's own state space, which is the surviving open content of the colour conjecture. And the truncation mechanism — why the observable-scale symmetry should be a finite-dimensional Lie group rather than the full groupoid symmetry — has no derivation; every use of the phrase "freeze-out" in this appendix is a heuristic label for that gap, not an explanation.
